thread:
anya: quick notes from the SR + focus-history pass I did this morning :wave:
anya: 1) after closing the side filter modal the focus lands at the top of the page instead of back on the filter button — NVDA reads nothing about the modal closing
anya: 2) toasts for 'filters applied' are not announced (we're using a visually-hidden live element but it's `aria-hidden` in some themes)
anya: 3) focus ring for compact table rows in high-contrast mode is almost invisible — matches bg too closely
anya: 4) token-cost tooltip in model card is `role=\"tooltip\"` but the trigger is a span, not keyboard-focusable
anya: filing a quick audit doc + screenshots in the design folder, posting blockers here :eyes:

mateo: thanks — good catch. can you paste the exact modal close flow? is it a `dialog` with `aria-modal` or a custom panel?

anya: it's our reusable SidePanel component. we set `role=\"dialog\"` but we never move focus into the panel on open, and we don't restore focus reliably on close. sometimes focus ends up on the page container.

mateo: that explains it. minimal fixes: on open call `panel.focus()` (a focusable close button), trap focus while open, and on close call `trigger.focus()` — also ensure the close emits an `aria-live` polite announcement like \"Filters closed\" if we don't have a visual toast.

jia: small code sketch for restore focus — put this on the SidePanel controller:
```
// after close
if (triggerEl && typeof triggerEl.focus === 'function') {
  triggerEl.focus();
}
// announce
liveRegion.textContent = 'Filters closed. Results updated.';
```
jia: also make the live region `aria-live=\"polite\"` and visible-to-sr-only (but not aria-hidden).

eli: re: tooltips — change the span trigger to a `<button aria-describedby=\"token-tooltip\">` or add `tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\"` and keyboard handlers. also update the tooltip to use `role=\"tooltip\"` and manage `aria-hidden` on show/hide.

anya: agreed. for contrast: the compact-row focus outline uses `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)` which disappears in high-contrast; propose we switch to `outline: 3px solid var(--focus-strong)` for that theme. i'll drop exact color tokens in the doc.

accessibility-bot: automated scan run (design/console-audit-2026-03-23) — issues flagged: 7 total (2 critical: focusable element not reachable by keyboard; 1 high: live region not exposed). Link: https://ci.redwood/axe/scan/3421 :warning:

mateo: can we get a short prioritized list? i'd say: 1) modal focus trap + restore 2) make token trigger keyboard-focusable 3) fix live region visibility 4) strengthen focus styles in high-contrast 5) run a quick axe scan after changes.

anya: i'll create tickets and assign — taking 1+3+4. jia can you pick up 2? eli can you run the after-change scan and add test steps?

jia: taking 2. will add unit tests for keyboard and a small e2e for tooltip keyboard access. :white_check_mark:

eli: will run scans and post results here. also recommend a short checklist so PMs can verify regressions: keyboard nav, screen reader announce, focus return, contrast.

anya: perfect. pushed the audit doc + screenshots to design drive and created issues: #5538 (modal focus), #5539 (live region), #5540 (contrast). linking in the tickets the snippet above and the accessibility-bot scan.

mateo: thanks — post PRs as drafts and tag `@design` + `@eng-accessibility` for quick review. low-risk change, let's aim to include in next sprint. :rocket:

anya: thanks all, closing thread after PRs are up.
